##### Project general facts

DG West by Reportage Properties is a striking high-rise project that combines residential and hotel apartments in one modern tower, offering a sophisticated lifestyle with excellent comfort and functionality. The project includes studios, 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom apartments, along with retail and convenience outlets and dedicated business spaces within the building.

Residents can enjoy an impressive range of amenities, including a rooftop infinity pool, modern fitness center, yoga garden, residents’ lounge, private dining areas, kids’ daycare and play area, and dedicated pet-friendly facilities. The development also provides spa facilities, a jacuzzi, business and conference spaces, 24-hour concierge service, valet parking, and convenient retail options, creating an exceptional all-in-one living experience.

The apartments feature smart, well-planned layouts with open kitchens, comfortable living and dining areas, built-in wardrobe space, and balconies in selected units, creating stylish and practical interiors. The overall design has a clean and contemporary feel with carefully organized spaces, while the furniture, electronics, decorative items, and accessories shown in the brochure are presented for illustration and are not included as standard.

##### Location description and benefits

Nairobi is a vibrant and dynamic city that combines modern urban living with abundant green spaces and a welcoming atmosphere. As Kenya’s capital and a major regional hub, it offers residents a diverse selection of business, shopping, dining, and entertainment opportunities.

The city is known for its excellent variety of parks and outdoor spaces, providing residents with opportunities to enjoy nature and an active lifestyle. Nairobi National Park, along with numerous recreational areas and green neighborhoods, adds a distinctive sense of openness and tranquility to city living.

Nairobi also benefits from a growing infrastructure and a wide range of international schools, healthcare facilities, restaurants, and retail destinations. Its cosmopolitan character, year-round pleasant climate, and strong cultural scene make the city an attractive place for comfortable and connected everyday living.
